relationships.description: Kernel routing table (simplyaviary) has 10.22.0.1/32 dev wg-flock.
Kernel routing table (simplyaviary) has Blackholes, metric 4294967295.
Kernel routing table (simplyaviary) has Connected routes (proto kernel).
Kernel routing table (simplyaviary) has Everyone else's routes.
xdebbied reads the mesh spec each pass.
Each pass computes the wanted routes from the spec.
It lists only `ip -j route show proto 230`.
A proto 230 route no longer wanted is deleted.
A wanted route that is missing or different is set with `ip route replace ... proto 230`.
Missing blackholes are added (plan action BlackholeAdd); unlisted ones of ours removed (BlackholeDel).
Any real route beats a blackhole: metric 0 against 4294967295.

flows.name: One mesh pass
flows.description: How box 5 ends up with exactly its own routes, and nobody else's are touched.

transitions.description: Read the spec: one peer (box 0), no clients.
Wanted: the peer's /32 and the two /17 halves.
Have: whatever carries proto 230, and nothing more.
Remove ours that are no longer wanted.
Set the missing ones; a failure is logged and retried next pass.
Make sure the blackholes are there, at the worst metric.
While the links are up, the real routes win.
